final_state.U: all still-dynamic vertices outside Y0 union X0; equivalently X union Y in the final seeded-precoloring

construction.name: Q_ALL
construction.vertices: U plus one quotient node [C] per residual Y0 component C
construction.component_edges: no edges among quotient component nodes
construction.cross_edges: u-[C] iff u is complete to C

theorem_target: For every k>=1, each induced P_k in Q_ALL lifts to an induced P_k in G by replacing every [C] by an arbitrary representative z_C in C. Hence P7-free G implies P7-free Q_ALL.
proof_basis: Axiom (iv) plus connectedness of C implies each u in U is complete or anticomplete to C.
Edges/nonedges inside U are copied exactly.
No equality of lists, source types, witness masks, or B0 coarse signatures is used.

extra_branch_fact.all_components_coupled: In the post-seed-two state, S is nonempty, G\X0 is connected by axiom (i), and Y0 is anticomplete to S by axiom (iii). Therefore every residual Y0 component C has a neighbor u outside Y0 union X0; u is not in S and axiom (iv) makes u complete to C. Hence D_C is nonempty for every residual component.

firewalls: Q_ALL P7-free does not imply tractable List-4 coloring.
No selector theorem is bundled into this gate.
